entries.en: Maybe we should try to work this out.
I should've seen this coming.
This isn't the time to talk about this.
Both of you settle down. We can handle this like mature adults.
I won't have my crew fighting!
I love it when women fight over me!
You're special to me, Ash.
You were right to tell me, Liara. I feel the same way.
I never meant for you to get hurt. But Ash is the one I really care about.
I'll go talk with her in a while and see how she's doing.
Liara's stronger than she looks. She'll be fine.
I never meant for you to get hurt. But Liara's the one I really care about.
Why do I have to make a choice? Maybe the three of us could--
I'll go talk with her in a while. Give her a chance to cool down.
Ash is pretty tough. She'll be fine.
But you're special to me, Kaidan.
Look, I never meant for you to get hurt. But Kaidan's the one I really care about.
I knew this would happen.
Not now, Ash.
Everybody calm down.
Enough!
Catfight!
It's not like that.
Goodbye, Ash.
Can't I have you both?
Don't be.
Goodbye, Liara.
I'll check on her later.
Don't worry about her.
She just needs some time.
Not now, Alenko.
I'm sorry, Kaidan.
Goodbye, Kaidan.
She'll need some time.
Dr. T'soni? Commander? We need to talk. The three of us.
I may not know much about human relationships, but I understand the concept of jealousy.
A heart's a complex thing, Shepard. Yeah, I could blame you for indecision. But you think I've never been pulled in two directions?
I feel bad for him, Shepard. I hope he'll be okay.
I suppose you're right. I'm sorry you were put in this position, but...  I'm glad you chose me.
I'm surprised. You sounded so angry at me a minute ago.
I'll go talk with him in a while. Give him a chance to cool down.
Kaidan's a marine. He'll be fine.
You don't blame me?
I'll check on him later.
He just needs some time.
This is stupid.
Or yours. No one likes to feel like they're not good enough to get what they want.
I hope you two will be happy together.
If you don't mind, I need to clean my gear.
That's a surprise. A second ago, you seemed ready to break her neck.
I don't believe we should continue this discussion here in the com room, Shepard. You know where to find me if you want to have a more private conversation.
Let's not talk about this here. It's not really the right setting for intimate conversation. You know where to find me.
Look, I'm not really comfortable discussing this here in the com room. You know where to find me when you're ready to talk.
Commander? We need to talk. You, me and Liara.
Commander - we need to talk. You, me and the asari.
Don't worry about him.
Commander? You look... pale. Are you suffering any ill effects from the Cipher?
That was incredible! All this time. All my research. Yet I never dreamed... I'm sorry. The images were so vivid. I never imagined the experience would be so... intense.
You are remarkably strong-willed, Commander. What you've been through, what you've seen, would have destroyed a lesser mind.
Did you see anything?
Come on. Get to the point. What did you see?
I think it's obvious there's a connection between the Reapers, the Prothean extinction, and the Conduit. But I didn't see anything that would help us find it.
I was able to interpret the data relayed through your vision. What was there, at least. But something was missing.
Saren must have the missing information. Maybe he found another beacon. If we can find the missing data from your vision I can-- whoa!
Are you okay, Commander? You look a little pale.
It's that damn Cipher! That asari messed you up good! And for what? We still don't know where to find that stupid Conduit! What a waste!
We still have another lead, Commander. That asari scientist in the Artemis Tau cluster. The Matriarch's daughter. She's an expert on the Protheans. Maybe she knows something.
I might be able to help you. I am an expert on the Protheans. If I join my consciousness to yours maybe we can make some sense of it.
It's... it's a distress call. A message sent out across the Prothean Empire. A warning against the Reapers. But the warning came too late.
Saren will have his entire fleet orbiting Ilos. You'll never make it down to the surface without reinforcements. You need to alert the Council. We need a fleet to-- whoa!
I'm sorry. The joining is... exhausting. I should go to the medical bay and lie down for a moment.
Your role in our communion is passive. I am the one who must submerge myself in your mind. Drown myself in your thoughts. It's more difficult than it looks.
The human subconscious instinctively resists the joining, Commander. A strong personality like yours makes it even harder.
That won't be necessary. I just need some rest. Somewhere quiet.
The Cipher shook me up a bit.
I just need some time to let this Cipher do its thing.
My brain's been scrambled like an egg! How do you think I feel?
She said it could take a while. I needed the Cipher. It's going to lead us to the Conduit. I'm just not sure how yet.
The Cipher's going to lead us to the Conduit. I'm just not sure how yet.
You're right. We've been on a wild goose chase this whole time.
Don't worry. We'll deal with her soon enough. Crew dismissed.
I feel strange.
I'm fine.
I was just brain-probed!
Give it time.
It wasn't a waste.
This is pointless!
She might.
I've sent off the Feros report, Commander. You want me to patch you through to the Council?
Without the Cipher, the images in your visions were never clear. It's only now that I recognized them as landmarks from Ilos.
I recognized some of the landmarks from photos and vids I'd seen during my research. I know of Ilos. I just don't know where it is.
I'm afraid so. Unless you somehow find the coordinates for the Mu Relay. Then it would be possible to-- whoa!
You must have seen something.
We have to get to Ilos!
That's not much help.
Time's short.
We have to hurry.
Did you learn anything?
We'll find her.
Commander. Is this some kind of game? Are you calling in a report just so you can cut us off again?
Understandable. You're under a great deal of stress. Things would have been easier if Exogeni had warned you about the Thorian.
You don't make demands on us, Shepard. Spectres answer to the Council, not the other way around!
We did. Things would have been easier if Exogeni had warned you about the Thorian.
Of course, Commander. We received your files on Feros. Things would have been much easier if Exogeni had told you about the Thorian.
That never gets old, does it?
Commander. Exogeni should have told us about the Thorian. It would have made your job much easier.
You might have been able to capture it for study instead of destroying it.
Yes, kill it. That's how you humans usually deal with things you don't understand.
Perhaps it's for the best, then. At least the colony was saved.
Of course it was saved. Shepard would go to any lengths to help a human colony.
Admirable. But sometimes Spectres have to make sacrifices. I hope you're willing to do that when the time comes.
That's good, Commander. Stopping Saren is your primary goal. Everything else is secondary.
Yes, I'm sure you're correct, Commander. It's unfortunate the colony couldn't be saved.
I'm surprised, Shepard. Feros was a human colony. I thought you'd go to any lengths to save your own kind.
Sometimes sacrifices have to be made, Commander. I'm glad you understand that.
Goodbye, Commander. We'll be waiting for your next report.
Oh! Lost the connection, ma'am. Sorry.
Uh-oh. So-- I'm sorry. I'm sorry, sir. We lost that connection.
I lost my temper.
Don't piss me off and I won't disconnect you.
Did you get my file on Feros?
You need to back off and let me do my job!
Goodbye, Councilor.
You know it.
The Thorian liked to enslave minds. Anyone who studied it would've ended up as one of its thralls.
Exogeni tried to study it. Look how that turned out.
The only reason to study a creature like that is to figure out how to kill it.
The Thorian wasn't complicated. It enslaved and killed innocent civilians.
The Thorian enslaved and killed innocent civilians!
Being human had nothing to do with it. They were in trouble.
I never jeopardized the mission!
I would've saved the colony if I could. It didn't work out that way.
The mission comes first.
Not unless I have to.
Did you read the report?
This is my mission!
Better off this way.
That wouldn't work
Don't be stupid!
I understood it.
It deserved to die!
I help everyone.
Not any lengths.
I wanted to help them.
Saren's all that matters.
We need to hurry, Commander. My-- Benezia said she transmitted the Mu Relay's coordinates to Saren. He may have already gone through.
We can't follow him! That relay's inside the Terminus Systems. They're not fond of Alliance ships over there. Or Spectres.
Saren probably has his whole fleet in orbit around Ilos. You will never make it down to the surface without reinforcements.
You need to alert the Council. They will assemble a fleet to accompany you. It is our only hope.
What's our next move, Commander? Head for the Mu Relay?
